user: What is my daily card limit?
answer:
Your daily limit on file for your tier (tier1) is **EUR 5,000**. As of 2026-09-15 you have not used any of it today, so the full EUR 5,000 remains.

My limit data covers transfer limits in general and does not break out a separate card-specific daily limit. If you need that figure, I can search the knowledge base for card limit rules or escalate to a human agent.

**Support conversation summary: TX-0401 dispute eligibility**

- **Transaction:** TX-0401, EUR 240.00, dated 2026-07-20. Status passed the tx_status check. Compliance hold check passed.
- **Customer ID / account ID:** Not provided. Agent said it would need the account the transaction was made from if the customer has more than one.
- **Eligibility check as of 2026-09-15:**

| Reason code | Window (days) | Eligible | Deadline to open |
|---|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | 60 | Yes | 2026-09-18 (earliest) |
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 | Yes | 2026-11-17 |
| goods_not_received | 90 | Yes | 2026-10-18 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 | Yes | 2026-10-18 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 | No | Window expired 2026-09-14 |

- **Reason codes offered to the customer** (customer must choose; agent cannot infer from TX ID): duplicate_charge (charged twice), fraud_card_not_present (used without involvement, online/phone), goods_not_received, service_not_rendered, unauthorized_debit (ineligible).
- **Commitments made:** Agent will not file any dispute until the customer confirms the reason code. Once confirmed, agent will open the dispute.
- **Not yet done:** No dispute has been filed. No reason code has been selected.

**Relevant policy notes:**
- Review target: 10 business days for card reason codes; 20 business days for transfer codes. Complex foreign-acquirer cases may take up to 45 calendar days, and the customer is notified if so.
- Withdrawal is final. The same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
- Each state change generates a customer notification. Notifications name the state, not the internal reason for a decision.
